dc_title_s: Snow Plow Routes, City of Oshkosh, WI 2026
dc_description_s: This data represents snow plow routes for the City of Oshkosh, Wisconsin in 2026. [Overview This data provides route information for snow plowing operations. It supports roadway maintenance planning by identifying the routes used by plow trucks and organizing them for operational use. Feature Layer Plow Routes: Line features representing snow plow route segments. The layer includes route naming, direction, address range information, route revision details, assigned truck information, and route length measurements that support routing and winter maintenance management. Use Cases Planning and dispatching snow plow operations Managing route priorities for roadway clearing Supporting winter maintenance workflows and route review Referencing route assignments in GIS applications Geographic Coverage The service covers a local roadway network within a defined municipal or county area.]
uw_supplemental_s: This is an archived copy of the data held at UW-Madison.
